name: Trying Times

angles.text: Healthy gryphons matter to Alliance travel and communication across Khaz Modan, especially when local dangers threaten regional security.
As a dwarf, you know an ill-tempered gryphon can be as dangerous as an enemy. Feed and care for her before flight.
As a gnome, you may hear Howin compare Razormaw egg yolks to a gnome's noggin, a vivid dwarven measure.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather is a dwarf who tends Bassbeak, his gryphon in the Wetlands. He asks for fresh raptor eggs to feed her before carrying out his plans.
Bassbeak is Howin Kindfeather's gryphon. When hungry, she grows irritable and dangerous, making it unsafe to ride her before she has eaten.
Howin seeks Razormaw raptor eggs because he says untainted food is scarce in the Wetlands. Their large, nourishing yolks can satisfy Bassbeak's appetite.
faq.q: Why does Howin need raptor eggs?

faq.answer: Razormaw raptors live at Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest in the Wetlands. Their nests hold the eggs Howin seeks.
faq.q: Where can Razormaw raptors be found?

faq.answer: Howin asks for eggs without cracks or flaws so Bassbeak gets fresh, untainted food instead of spoiled scraps.
faq.q: Why do the eggs need to be perfect?

aliases: what are howin and bassbeak planning
faq.answer: Howin has a broader plan for Bassbeak, but its details wait until she is fed and calm enough to fly safely amid the region's dangers.
faq.q: What is Howin planning to do with Bassbeak?

sections.body: Howin Kindfeather tends Bassbeak in the Wetlands. The dwarf will not fly with his gryphon until her hunger is eased. A hungry gryphon can be stubborn and unpredictable. She may lash out, so a proper meal must come before any flight through the marshes.
sections.title: Appeasing a Hungry Gryphon

sections.body: Howin seeks food for Bassbeak among the Razormaw raptors. Their nests lie at Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest. Razormaw eggs have yolks as large as a gnome's head. Howin wants those substantial meals to satisfy Bassbeak before she faces the dangers of the Wetlands.
sections.title: The Razormaw Bounty

summary: Before Howin Kindfeather can fly through the Wetlands, Bassbeak needs a meal. He seeks a dozen intact eggs from the fierce Razormaw raptors.
